result.title: GLIMPSE: Global-Local Indexing with Multi-Precision Spectral Encoding for Explorable Video World Models
result.summary: A camera-controlled video world model must keep a scene consistent when the camera returns to it. Memories that render stored features into the target frame can turn depth and pose errors into ghosting or duplicated structure. Positional transport avoids that resampling by relocating a historical patch's address rather than its content, but assigns full positional precision even to inaccurate projections. We present GLIMPSE, a global-local memory interface with band-wise multi-precision coordinates and geometry-conditioned spectral attenuation to reduce sensitivity to inaccurate projected addresses. Local patch memory supplies view-specific appearance, while recurrent global memory provides scene context. Footprint-guided retrieval selects historical patches under a fixed local read budget. Under matched retrieval and read budgets, GLIMPSE improves geometric correspondence and photometric consistency over deterministic positional transport.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 GLIMPSE，一种面向相机可控视频世界模型的全局-局部记忆接口：用分带多精度坐标与几何条件谱衰减，降低对不准确投影地址的敏感性，并以足迹引导的检索在固定读取预算下选取历史 patch。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「重定位历史 patch 地址而非重采样内容」及固定读取预算下的检索策略，可能为 LVR 中 latent 视觉记忆的预算分配、证据筛选与位置精度处理提供可核查的方法线索，但原论文并未涉及 VLM 推理。
